cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Count What I Did
cards.instruction: Make someone acknowledge the practical work, time, or inconvenience you contributed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've got the shopping organized. Twelve bags up six flights; let's make sure nobody calls that a quick shop.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I won't. Sit down and I'll put it all away.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good, that's the recovery plan. Put it wherever suits you. The peas came up on a separate trip, though.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then have two rests. I'll bring tea after the first.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent. Could you say 'tea for the second trip' when you bring it? Quietly is fine. I just don't want my well-managed recovery mistaken for one long sit.

reason: Keep the warm rest/tea causal game but make A adopt B organizing help and negotiate the announcement of effort beneath managerial confidence.
